desc: This luxe, rooftop lounge restaurant serves dishes from across India and South Asia with city views.
addr: 13th Floor, Tower-B, 84, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Haridevpur, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t:
A perfect rooftop escape in the middle of the city 🌃✨

We visited this place last night and the ambience truly stole the show. Super …

I visited this restaurant with my friends for lunch yesterday and had an excellent experience. It is one of those places in Bangalore that gives you an instant warm and cosy vibe the moment you walk in. …

Went there as part of team lunch from my company.
So many options to choose from.
Quality, presentation and the taste of food is good. Price is on the higher side.
